text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O got injured during training,
so I rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for causing you trouble.
I've gotten treated, so I'm doing much better now.
choice_data_list: Let's rest up and recover for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um... Is it really okay for me to be resting?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"My father, who was a sumo wrestler,
would keep practicing thoroughly at his own pace
even when he was injured."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, day by day...
I believe building up those small efforts creates a version of myself that won't give in to adversity.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to keep training...!
I won't overdo it, I'll properly pace myself,
I promise!
choice_data_list: It's too dangerous with that injury.
Okay, let's figure out what we can do

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking straight.
You're right, there's a chance it could get worse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it easy today
so I can return to training soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O sounded disappointed
as she headed back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Thank you so much!
Let's head to the gym right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Ow-ow-ow...! Just walking sends
throbbing pain through me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maybe she means... I shouldn't just run on sheer willpower, and need to consider my body more...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If it gets worse, it'll all be for nothing, right...?
Trainer, I'll take it easy and rest today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With frustration in her voice, Sakura Chiyono O
slowly walked back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I'll make sure not to overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I started by doing some stretches,
and surprisingly, I felt totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Next, I think I'll try some training
that won't put strain on the injured area.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O trained carefully,
staying mindful of her injury without pushing herself too hard.
